items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Ned Williams came to me and said, that William Morris, Jr., wanted me to get a band department.

ctx.x: Well, actually how that came about was just before that, after I broke up with MCA, I was deciding what to do, I had a little group at the Hickory House -- with Aaron and, you know, some more people -- Remo Palmieri, (unintelligible) and Ned Williams came to me and said, that William Morris, Jr., wanted me to get a band department. He wanted Duke Ellington and he always liked the band that I had in the '30's, so
he wanted me to get a big band. So I did. I got -- I formed a band. Five woodwinds and six brass. And three rhythm.
